"""A small write-hook policy for workspace-relative POSIX paths."""

from pathlib import PurePosixPath


def allow_write(path: str) -> bool:
    parts = PurePosixPath(path)
    return not parts.is_absolute() and ".." not in parts.parts and bool(parts.parts) and parts.parts[0] == "workspace"
